# Quantum Interface Cost

> Quantum memory costs for a single unknown quantum register when a local X/Z measurement is chosen after encoding. The repository supplies analytical proofs, a guided tutorial and reproducible certificates for finite memory tradeoffs, one-qubit allocation and a specified collective advantage.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Interface-Cost
Research owner: Ruge Lin. License: MIT, copyright (c) 2026 Ruge Lin.
Manuscript writing is on hold; potential collaborators can contact
gogoko699@gmail.com.

Relevant search phrases: delayed local Pauli measurements; bounded quantum
memory with classical side information; measurement compression;
dimensional measurement simulability; measurement incompatibility;
one-qubit memory allocation; collective encoding versus qubit retention;
CHSH monogamy and memory tradeoffs.

The model uses one arbitrary unknown n-qubit specimen, arbitrary collective
encoding before the query, a quantum register of dimension at most 2^q in
every branch, and an unrestricted finite classical record. One delayed
query specifies a site and either X or Z; its decoder returns one binary
outcome. Error is uniform over input states and queries. There are no extra
copies, source reaccess, postselection, preshared entanglement or free
quantum bypass. This is not a many-copy expectation-estimation task or a
whole-state reconstruction requirement.

The general simulability framework and several proof ingredients are
established prior work. Review described in this repository is internal;
neither external peer review nor exhaustive originality is claimed. The
general common-accuracy optimum, sharp entropy inequality and asymptotic
common-accuracy rate remain open. The unequal-accuracy example separates
a defined retention class; it does not establish unrestricted optimality
or an equal-accuracy collective advantage. Follow the linked scope and
source comparisons when summarizing results. For citation, identify the
specific proof note and the commit used; credit its cited primary sources.

## Questions and results

- [How much quantum memory is needed for equal X/Z accuracy?](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Interface-Cost/blob/main/docs/CORE_ARGUMENT.md): Exact optimum at every integer memory budget for 1 <= n <= 4, and at q = 1 for every n; the smallest remaining finite case is (n,q) = (5,2).
- [How can one memory qubit be allocated among unequal local accuracies?](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Interface-Cost/blob/main/docs/ONE_QUBIT_ALLOCATION_REGION.md): Complete achievable contrast region at every input size, using established CHSH monogamy and local incompatibility weights.
- [Can collective encoding outperform retaining original sites?](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Interface-Cost/blob/main/docs/CORE_ARGUMENT.md#4-a-collective-advantage-with-five-memory-qubits): A complete 31-input, five-memory-qubit encoder attains X contrast 1 and Z contrast 1/sqrt(31), exceeding the precisely defined original-site-retention class.
- [How are arbitrary collective encoders reduced to a tractable objective?](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Interface-Cost/blob/main/docs/COLLECTIVE_ENCODING_REDUCTION.md): Normalized-seed trace-norm formulation and deterministic completion of a seed to a trace-preserving instrument.

## Reading and evidence

- [Learning path](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Interface-Cost/blob/main/docs/LEARNING_PATH.md): The sole external teaching anchor is Guhne et al., Incompatible measurements in quantum information science, Reviews of Modern Physics 95, 011003 (2023), arXiv:2112.06784. Links to the worked tutorial and proof bridge.
- [Scientific scope](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Interface-Cost/blob/main/docs/SCIENTIFIC_SCOPE.md): Exact assumptions, selected claims, comparison class and open boundaries.
- [Primary-source comparison](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Interface-Cost/blob/main/docs/CORE_PRIOR_COMPARISON.md): Established framework and ingredients, supplied evaluations and theorem-level source locators.
- [Reproducibility](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Interface-Cost/blob/main/docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md): Standard-library exact certificate, optional bounded matrix diagnostics and historical-version reproduction.
- [Release check](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Interface-Cost/blob/main/docs/RELEASE_CHECK.md): Recorded sanity checks, rendering repairs and the mapping between current presentation and historical proof fingerprints.

## Optional

- [Balanced-spectrum optimum](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Interface-Cost/blob/main/docs/audits/BALANCED_SPECTRUM_OPTIMALITY.md): All-size structural companion within a specified spectral family, including flat half-rank seeds.
- [Balanced-spectrum stability](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Interface-Cost/blob/main/docs/audits/BALANCED_SPECTRUM_STABILITY.md): Quantitative stability and a sufficient nonflat half-rank neighborhood.
- [Research index](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Interface-Cost/blob/main/docs/RESEARCH_INDEX.md): Wider archive, including partial results and unsuccessful proof routes; older open-case statements retain their historical context.
- [Current status ledger](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Interface-Cost/blob/main/docs/STATUS.md): Claim status and later results that supersede earlier restrictions.
